    int vertexCount;        // Number of vertices stored in arrays
    int triangleCount;      // Number of triangles stored (indexed or not)

    // Vertex attributes data
    float *vertices;        // Vertex position (XYZ - 3 components per vertex) (shader-location = 0)
    float *texcoords;       // Vertex texture coordinates (UV - 2 components per vertex) (shader-location = 1)
    float *texcoords2;      // Vertex texture second coordinates (UV - 2 components per vertex) (shader-location = 5)
    float *normals;         // Vertex normals (XYZ - 3 components per vertex) (shader-location = 2)

    unsigned char *colors;      // Vertex colors (RGBA - 4 components per vertex) (shader-location = 3)
    unsigned short *indices;    // Vertex indices (in case vertex data comes indexed)

    // Animation vertex data
    float *animVertices;    // Animated vertex positions (after bones transformations)
    float *animNormals;     // Animated normals (after bones transformations)
    unsigned char *boneIds; // Vertex bone ids, max 255 bone ids, up to 4 bones influence by vertex (skinning) (shader-location = 6)
    float *boneWeights;     // Vertex bone weight, up to 4 bones influence by vertex (skinning) (shader-location = 7)
    Matrix *boneMatrices;   // Bones animated transformation matrices
    int boneCount;          // Number of bones

    // OpenGL identifiers

    unsigned int *vboId;    // OpenGL Vertex Buffer Objects id (default vertex data)

    RL_ATTACHMENT_COLOR_CHANNEL4 = 4,       // Framebuffer attachment type: color 4
    RL_ATTACHMENT_COLOR_CHANNEL5 = 5,       // Framebuffer attachment type: color 5
    RL_ATTACHMENT_COLOR_CHANNEL6 = 6,       // Framebuffer attachment type: color 6
    RL_ATTACHMENT_COLOR_CHANNEL7 = 7,       // Framebuffer attachment type: color 7
    RL_ATTACHMENT_DEPTH = 100,              // Framebuffer attachment type: depth
    RL_ATTACHMENT_STENCIL = 200,            // Framebuffer attachment type: stencil,
} rlFramebufferAttachType;
objects.description: Attachment slots for FBOs: up to 8 color targets, plus depth and stencil.
Specifies the texture target type when attaching resources to an FBO (2D, cubemap faces, or renderbuffers).
Face culling modes for rlSetCullFace.
2D vector with floating-point components x and y. Used across vector and matrix operations for 2D math utilities.
3D vector with floating-point components x, y, z. Core type for 3D math and transformations.
4D vector with floating-point components x, y, z, w. Serves both as a generic 4D vector and as the underlying storage for Quaternion.

objects.definition: typedef Vector4 Quaternion;
objects.description: Quaternion represented as {x, y, z, w} stored in a Vector4. Used for rotations and orientation math.
4x4 transformation matrix stored in row-major memory layout, but math semantics assume column-major (OpenGL style). Used for transforms, projections, and view matrices.
Helper type that wraps a 3-float array for returning Vector3 as a contiguous float buffer (e.g., Vector3ToFloatV).
Helper type that wraps a 16-float array for returning Matrix as a contiguous float buffer (e.g., MatrixToFloatV).

functions.name: InitWindow
functions.signature: void InitWindow(int width, int height, const char *title);
functions.description: Initialize the OS window and the OpenGL context. Call this once at startup before using any other window, input, or drawing functions.
requirements: Must be called before most other window/input/graphics functions.
width and height should be positive integers (in pixels).
title should point to a valid, null-terminated UTF-8 string.
Only one active window/context is supported by raylib at a time.

functions.name: CloseWindow
functions.description: Close the window and unload the OpenGL context and any internal state attached to it. Call at shutdown.
requirements: Should be called once when the application is done with rendering.
Do not call rendering or window functions that require a valid context after closing.

functions.name: WindowShouldClose
functions.description: Return true if the user requested the application to close (e.g., pressed ESC or clicked the window close button). Typically used as the main loop condition.
requirements: Window must have been initialized with InitWindow() before calling.

functions.name: IsWindowReady
functions.description: Check if the window has been successfully initialized and is ready for use.
requirements: Returns false until InitWindow() completes successfully.

functions.name: IsWindowFullscreen
functions.description: Check whether the window is currently in fullscreen mode.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: IsWindowHidden
functions.description: Check whether the window is currently hidden.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: IsWindowMinimized
functions.description: Check whether the window is currently minimized (iconified).
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: IsWindowMaximized
functions.description: Check whether the window is currently maximized.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: IsWindowFocused
functions.description: Check whether the window is currently focused (has input focus).
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: IsWindowResized
functions.description: Check if the window size changed during the last frame.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
Call per-frame; value reflects the last frame’s state.

functions.name: IsWindowState
functions.description: Check if a specific window configuration flag is currently enabled (see ConfigFlags).
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
flag must be a valid combination/bit from ConfigFlags.

functions.name: SetWindowState
functions.description: Enable one or more window configuration flags (bitmask).
requirements: Usually called before window creation to set startup behavior; runtime effects depend on flag type.
flags must be a bitwise OR of ConfigFlags constants.

functions.name: ClearWindowState
functions.description: Disable one or more window configuration flags (bitmask).
requirements: Runtime effects depend on the specific flags and platform.
flags must be a bitwise OR of ConfigFlags constants.
Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: ToggleFullscreen
functions.description: Toggle the window between fullscreen and windowed modes. Resizes monitor to match window resolution when entering fullscreen.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
Graphics context will be reconfigured; ensure resources tolerate resize.

functions.name: ToggleBorderlessWindowed
functions.description: Toggle borderless windowed mode. Resizes the window to match the monitor resolution.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
Window decorations and size behavior change according to mode.

functions.name: MaximizeWindow
functions.description: Maximize the window (if resizable).
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
Only effective when FLAG_WINDOW_RESIZABLE is enabled.

functions.name: MinimizeWindow
functions.description: Minimize (iconify) the window (if resizable).
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
Effect may depend on platform/window manager.

functions.name: RestoreWindow
functions.description: Restore the window from a minimized or maximized state to normal.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: SetWindowIcon
functions.description: Set the window icon using a single image.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
image must be RGBA 32-bit per the comment.
The Image must be valid; ownership/lifetime after call is unchanged (not specified).

functions.name: SetWindowIcons
functions.description: Set the window icon(s) using multiple images (typically different sizes).
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
images must point to an array of count valid Image entries in RGBA 32-bit format.
count must be >= 1.

functions.name: SetWindowTitle
functions.description: Set the window title text.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
title must be a valid, null-terminated UTF-8 string.

functions.name: SetWindowPosition
functions.description: Move the window to the given screen coordinates.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
Coordinates are in screen space (top-left origin).

functions.name: SetWindowMonitor
functions.description: Move the window to a different monitor.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
monitor must be in range [0, GetMonitorCount()-1].

functions.name: SetWindowMinSize
functions.description: Set the minimum window size constraints. Only applies when FLAG_WINDOW_RESIZABLE is set.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
Effective only when FLAG_WINDOW_RESIZABLE is enabled.
width and height should be non-negative; behavior with zero is platform-dependent (not specified).

functions.name: SetWindowMaxSize
functions.description: Set the maximum window size constraints. Only applies when FLAG_WINDOW_RESIZABLE is set.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
Effective only when FLAG_WINDOW_RESIZABLE is enabled.
width and height should be >= current min size; negative values not specified.

functions.name: SetWindowSize
functions.description: Resize the window to the given dimensions.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
width and height should be positive integers.
If the window is not resizable, the call may be ignored by the platform.

functions.name: SetWindowOpacity
functions.description: Set the window opacity (transparency) from 0.0 to 1.0.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
opacity must be in range [0.0f..1.0f].
Platform support may vary.

functions.name: SetWindowFocused
functions.description: Request focus for the window.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
Actual focusing behavior depends on OS policies.

functions.name: GetWindowHandle
functions.description: Return the underlying native window handle pointer for platform-specific use.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
Returned pointer type/usage is platform-specific; use with care.

functions.name: GetScreenWidth
functions.description: Get the current logical screen width of the window (framebuffer).
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: GetScreenHeight
functions.description: Get the current logical screen height of the window (framebuffer).
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: GetRenderWidth
functions.description: Get the current render width considering HiDPI scaling.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: GetRenderHeight
functions.description: Get the current render height considering HiDPI scaling.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: GetMonitorCount
functions.description: Get the number of connected monitors.

functions.name: GetCurrentMonitor
functions.description: Get the index of the monitor where the window is currently placed.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: GetMonitorPosition
functions.description: Get the top-left position of the specified monitor in virtual screen coordinates.
requirements: monitor must be in range [0, GetMonitorCount()-1].

functions.name: GetMonitorWidth
functions.description: Get the current mode width of the specified monitor.
requirements: monitor must be in range [0, GetMonitorCount()-1].

functions.name: GetMonitorHeight
functions.description: Get the current mode height of the specified monitor.
requirements: monitor must be in range [0, GetMonitorCount()-1].

functions.name: GetMonitorPhysicalWidth
functions.description: Get the physical width of the specified monitor in millimeters.
requirements: monitor must be in range [0, GetMonitorCount()-1].

functions.name: GetMonitorPhysicalHeight
functions.description: Get the physical height of the specified monitor in millimeters.
requirements: monitor must be in range [0, GetMonitorCount()-1].

functions.name: GetMonitorRefreshRate
functions.description: Get the refresh rate of the specified monitor.
requirements: monitor must be in range [0, GetMonitorCount()-1].

functions.name: GetWindowPosition
functions.description: Get the window position in screen coordinates.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: GetWindowScaleDPI
functions.description: Get the window’s DPI scaling factors (x,y).
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: GetMonitorName
functions.description: Get a human-readable UTF-8 monitor name for the specified monitor index.
requirements: monitor must be in range [0, GetMonitorCount()-1].
Returned pointer must be treated as read-only; lifetime/ownership unspecified (do not free).

functions.name: SetClipboardText
functions.description: Set the system clipboard text contents.
requirements: text must be a valid, null-terminated string.
Platform clipboard availability may vary.

functions.name: GetClipboardText
functions.description: Get the current system clipboard text contents.
requirements: Returned pointer is const; lifetime/ownership unspecified.
If no text is available, implementation may return an empty string or NULL (not specified).

functions.name: GetClipboardImage
functions.description: Get the current system clipboard image contents, if any, as a raylib Image.
requirements: If a non-empty Image is returned, manage it like other Images; freeing with UnloadImage() is inferred from raylib patterns (not explicitly stated).
Availability depends on platform clipboard.

functions.name: EnableEventWaiting
functions.description: Enable waiting for events on EndDrawing(); disables automatic event polling, causing EndDrawing() to block for events.
requirements: Affects how EndDrawing() processes events; use consistently within the frame loop.

functions.name: DisableEventWaiting
functions.description: Disable waiting for events on EndDrawing(); enables automatic event polling each frame.
requirements: Use consistently within the frame loop to avoid unexpected blocking behavior.

functions.name: ShowCursor
functions.description: Show the OS mouse cursor.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: HideCursor
functions.description: Hide the OS mouse cursor.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: IsCursorHidden
functions.description: Check whether the OS mouse cursor is currently hidden.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: EnableCursor
functions.description: Unlock and display the OS cursor (enables free cursor).
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: DisableCursor
functions.description: Lock and hide the OS cursor (disable free cursor).
requirements: Requires an initialized window.
Locking behavior depends on OS (may confine to window).

functions.name: IsCursorOnScreen
functions.description: Check if the OS cursor is within the screen bounds.
requirements: Requires an initialized window.

functions.name: ClearBackground
functions.description: Clear the current render target to the given color (framebuffer clear). Call between BeginDrawing() and EndDrawing().
requirements: Must be called between BeginDrawing() and EndDrawing().

functions.name: BeginDrawing
functions.description: Begin drawing to the default framebuffer. Sets up the canvas for issuing draw calls.
requirements: Must be paired with a corresponding EndDrawing() each frame.
Do not nest BeginDrawing() calls.

functions.name: EndDrawing
functions.description: Finish drawing, present the back buffer, handle frame timing and input events unless custom frame control is enabled.
requirements: Must be paired with a preceding BeginDrawing() in the same frame.
Do not call if BeginDrawing() failed or was not called.

functions.name: BeginMode2D
functions.description: Begin 2D drawing mode using the provided 2D camera (applies transform).
requirements: Must be paired with EndMode2D().
Can be nested appropriately with other Begin/End modes as documented by raylib; avoid improper nesting.

functions.name: EndMode2D
functions.description: End 2D drawing mode started by BeginMode2D().
requirements: Must follow a matching BeginMode2D() before other state changes.

functions.name: BeginMode3D
functions.description: Begin 3D drawing mode using the provided 3D camera (sets view/projection).
requirements: Must be paired with EndMode3D().
Avoid improper nesting with other Begin/End modes.

functions.name: EndMode3D
functions.description: End 3D drawing mode started by BeginMode3D(); returns to default 2D orthographic mode.
requirements: Must follow a matching BeginMode3D().

functions.name: BeginTextureMode
functions.description: Begin drawing to the given render texture (FBO). Subsequent draw calls render into target.
requirements: target must be a valid render texture (loaded).
Must be paired with EndTextureMode() before drawing to the screen again.
Do not free or unload target while active.

functions.name: EndTextureMode
functions.description: End drawing to the current render texture started by BeginTextureMode().
requirements: Must follow a matching BeginTextureMode().

functions.name: BeginShaderMode
functions.description: Begin drawing with a custom shader program; subsequent draw calls use this shader.
requirements: shader must be a valid, loaded Shader.
Must be paired with EndShaderMode().

functions.name: EndShaderMode
functions.description: End custom shader mode started by BeginShaderMode(); restore default shader.
requirements: Must follow a matching BeginShaderMode().

functions.name: BeginBlendMode
functions.description: Begin drawing with a specified blending mode (see BlendMode).
requirements: mode must be a valid BlendMode enum value.
Must be paired with EndBlendMode().

functions.name: EndBlendMode
functions.description: End the current blending mode started by BeginBlendMode(); restore default alpha blending.
requirements: Must follow a matching BeginBlendMode().

functions.name: BeginScissorMode
functions.signature: void BeginScissorMode(int x, int y, int width, int height);
functions.description: Begin scissor mode restricting drawing to the specified rectangle in screen coordinates.
requirements: Must be paired with EndScissorMode().
width and height should be non-negative.

functions.name: EndScissorMode
functions.description: End scissor mode started by BeginScissorMode().
requirements: Must follow a matching BeginScissorMode().

functions.name: BeginVrStereoMode
functions.description: Begin stereo VR rendering using the provided configuration (VR simulator).
requirements: config must be previously obtained with LoadVrStereoConfig().
Must be paired with EndVrStereoMode().

functions.name: EndVrStereoMode
functions.description: End stereo VR rendering started by BeginVrStereoMode().
requirements: Must follow a matching BeginVrStereoMode().

functions.name: LoadVrStereoConfig
functions.description: Create a stereo rendering configuration for a VR device using provided device parameters.
requirements: device fields should be properly filled (see VrDeviceInfo).
Returned VrStereoConfig should be later passed to UnloadVrStereoConfig() when no longer needed.

functions.name: UnloadVrStereoConfig
functions.description: Release resources associated with a VrStereoConfig created by LoadVrStereoConfig().
requirements: config must have been obtained from LoadVrStereoConfig().
Call once when finished with the VR stereo config.

functions.name: LoadShader
functions.description: Load a GPU shader program from vertex and fragment shader files and bind default locations. Use after a rendering context is created.
requirements: Must be called when a valid OpenGL context is available (not available on OpenGL 1.1).
File paths should point to accessible shader source files.
Resulting Shader should be checked with IsShaderValid() before use.
Unload with UnloadShader() when no longer needed.

functions.name: LoadShaderFromMemory
functions.description: Load a GPU shader program from in-memory vertex and fragment shader source strings and bind default locations.
requirements: Must be called when a valid OpenGL context is available (not available on OpenGL 1.1).
Input strings must be valid, null-terminated GLSL code for the respective stages.
Check the returned Shader with IsShaderValid() before use.
Unload with UnloadShader() when done.

functions.name: IsShaderValid
functions.description: Check if a shader object is valid (properly loaded on the GPU).
requirements: Pass a Shader previously returned by LoadShader/LoadShaderFromMemory.
Returns false if not valid or not loaded.

functions.name: GetShaderLocation
functions.description: Get the location (int) of a uniform variable in the given shader by name.
requirements: Shader must be valid and currently known to the GL context.
uniformName must be a null-terminated string matching a uniform in the shader.
Returned location is >= 0 on success, otherwise implementation-dependent (often -1).

functions.name: GetShaderLocationAttrib
functions.description: Get the location (int) of a vertex attribute in the given shader by name.
requirements: Shader must be valid and known to the GL context.
attribName must be a null-terminated string matching a vertex attribute in the shader.
Returned location is >= 0 on success, otherwise implementation-dependent (often -1).

functions.name: SetShaderValue
functions.signature: void SetShaderValue(Shader shader, int locIndex, const void *value, int uniformType);
functions.description: Set a single uniform value for a shader at a given uniform location and type.
requirements: Shader must be valid.
locIndex should be a valid uniform location obtained via GetShaderLocation().
value must point to data compatible with uniformType (see ShaderUniformDataType).
Call between BeginShaderMode(shader)/EndShaderMode() or before drawing that uses the shader.

functions.name: SetShaderValueV
functions.signature: void SetShaderValueV(Shader shader, int locIndex, const void *value, int uniformType, int count);
functions.description: Set a uniform vector/array value for a shader at a given uniform location, specifying count.
requirements: Shader must be valid.
locIndex should be a valid uniform location.
value must point to an array whose element type/size matches uniformType and count.
Use with matching ShaderUniformDataType for correct size.

functions.name: SetShaderValueMatrix
functions.signature: void SetShaderValueMatrix(Shader shader, int locIndex, Matrix mat);
functions.description: Set a 4x4 matrix uniform for a shader at a given uniform location.
requirements: Shader must be valid.
locIndex should be a valid matrix uniform location.
Matrix must be provided in the expected layout for the backend (raylib uses column-major, OpenGL-style).

functions.name: SetShaderValueTexture
functions.signature: void SetShaderValueTexture(Shader shader, int locIndex, Texture2D texture);
functions.description: Set a sampler2D uniform and bind the given texture to the shader at the appropriate texture unit.
requirements: Shader must be valid.
locIndex should be a valid sampler uniform location.
Texture must be a valid, loaded Texture2D.
Texture must remain valid for the draw using the shader.

functions.name: UnloadShader
functions.description: Unload a shader program from GPU memory (VRAM) and release associated resources.
requirements: Only pass shaders previously loaded with LoadShader/LoadShaderFromMemory.
Do not use the shader after unloading.

functions.name: GetScreenToWorldRay
functions.description: Compute a world-space ray originating from the camera through the given screen-space position.
requirements: Provide screen position in pixels relative to the current viewport.
Camera must be properly configured (projection, view).

functions.name: GetScreenToWorldRayEx
functions.signature: Ray GetScreenToWorldRayEx(Vector2 position, Camera camera, int width, int height);
functions.description: Compute a world-space ray from a screen position for a custom viewport size.
requirements: width and height should match the target viewport used for rendering.
Camera must be properly configured.

functions.name: GetWorldToScreen
functions.description: Project a 3D world-space position to 2D screen-space using the given camera.
requirements: Camera must be properly configured.
Result is in pixels relative to current viewport.

functions.name: GetWorldToScreenEx
functions.signature: Vector2 GetWorldToScreenEx(Vector3 position, Camera camera, int width, int height);
functions.description: Project a 3D world-space position to 2D screen coordinates using a custom viewport size.
requirements: width and height should correspond to the projection viewport.
Camera must be properly configured.

functions.name: GetWorldToScreen2D
functions.description: Transform a 2D world-space position into 2D screen-space using a 2D camera.
requirements: Camera2D must be properly configured (offset, target, rotation, zoom).

functions.name: GetScreenToWorld2D
functions.description: Transform a 2D screen-space position into 2D world-space using a 2D camera.
requirements: Camera2D must be properly configured.
Provide screen position in pixels in the current render surface.

functions.name: GetCameraMatrix
functions.description: Compute and return the 3D camera view matrix for the given camera configuration.
requirements: Camera must have valid position, target, up, projection, and fovy values.

functions.name: GetCameraMatrix2D
functions.description: Compute and return the 2D camera transform matrix for the given Camera2D.
requirements: Camera2D fields (offset/target/rotation/zoom) should be set appropriately.

functions.name: SetTargetFPS
functions.description: Set the target frames-per-second for the main loop timing.
requirements: fps should be a positive integer.
Affects how EndDrawing() (or custom loop) throttles frame time.

functions.name: GetFrameTime
functions.description: Return the time in seconds taken by the last rendered frame (delta time).

functions.name: GetTime
functions.description: Return the elapsed time in seconds since InitWindow() was called.

functions.name: GetFPS
functions.description: Return the current frames-per-second calculated by the internal timing system.

functions.name: SwapScreenBuffer
functions.description: Swap back buffer with front buffer to present the frame (screen drawing). For advanced manual frame control.
requirements: Intended for use when SUPPORT_CUSTOM_FRAME_CONTROL is enabled.
Requires a valid window/context.

functions.name: PollInputEvents
functions.description: Process and register all pending input events. For advanced manual frame control.
requirements: Intended for use when SUPPORT_CUSTOM_FRAME_CONTROL is enabled.
Call regularly to keep input state updated.

functions.name: WaitTime
functions.description: Sleep/halt program execution for the specified duration in seconds.
requirements: seconds should be non-negative.

functions.name: SetRandomSeed
functions.description: Seed the internal pseudo-random number generator.

functions.name: GetRandomValue
functions.description: Return a random integer in the inclusive range [min, max].
requirements: min must be less than or equal to max to avoid undefined behavior.

functions.name: LoadRandomSequence
functions.signature: int *LoadRandomSequence(unsigned int count, int min, int max);
functions.description: Generate a sequence of non-repeating random integers in [min, max]. Returns a dynamically allocated array.
requirements: count determines number of elements requested.
Range [min, max] must be large enough to supply 'count' unique values.
Returned memory must be freed with UnloadRandomSequence().

functions.name: UnloadRandomSequence
functions.description: Free a random sequence array previously returned by LoadRandomSequence().
requirements: Pass a pointer obtained from LoadRandomSequence(), or NULL to no-op.

functions.name: TakeScreenshot
functions.description: Capture the current screen and save it to a file. File extension determines output format.
requirements: fileName must include a supported image extension (e.g., .png, .jpg).
Requires a valid window/context and a rendered frame.

functions.name: SetConfigFlags
functions.description: Set initialization configuration flags prior to InitWindow().
requirements: Must be called before InitWindow() to take effect.
flags is a bit mask of ConfigFlags values.

functions.name: OpenURL
functions.description: Open the given URL using the system’s default web browser, if available.
requirements: url must be a valid, null-terminated URL string.

functions.name: SetTraceLogLevel
functions.description: Set the minimum trace log level; messages below this level are filtered out.
requirements: logLevel should be one of TraceLogLevel values.

functions.name: TraceLog
functions.description: Write a formatted trace log message at the given level (LOG_DEBUG, LOG_INFO, LOG_WARNING, LOG_ERROR, etc.).
requirements: logLevel should be from TraceLogLevel.
'text' is a printf-style format string; corresponding variadic arguments must match the format.

functions.name: SetTraceLogCallback
functions.description: Install a custom trace log callback to handle log messages.
requirements: callback must match signature void (*)(int, const char*, va_list).
Advanced usage; ensure callback is reentrant/thread-safe if required by app.

functions.name: MemAlloc
functions.description: Allocate memory using raylib’s internal allocator.
requirements: size is the number of bytes to allocate.
Returned pointer should be freed with MemFree().

functions.name: MemRealloc
functions.description: Reallocate a memory block previously obtained with MemAlloc/MemRealloc.
requirements: ptr is either NULL or a pointer from MemAlloc/MemRealloc.
Returned pointer should be freed with MemFree().

functions.name: MemFree
functions.description: Free memory previously allocated by MemAlloc/MemRealloc.
requirements: ptr should be a pointer returned by MemAlloc/MemRealloc or NULL.

functions.name: LoadFileData
functions.description: Load file contents into a newly allocated byte array; returns pointer and sets dataSize.
requirements: fileName must point to a readable file.
On success, returned memory must be freed with UnloadFileData().
dataSize must be a valid pointer to receive size, or NULL if size is not needed.

functions.name: UnloadFileData
functions.description: Unload file data previously allocated by LoadFileData().
requirements: data must be a pointer returned by LoadFileData() or NULL.

functions.name: SaveFileData
functions.signature: bool SaveFileData(const char *fileName, void *data, int dataSize);
functions.description: Write raw bytes to a file. Returns true on success.
requirements: fileName is the output path; parent directory must be writable.
data must point to a buffer at least dataSize bytes long.
dataSize is the number of bytes to write; should be >= 0.

functions.name: ExportDataAsCode
functions.signature: bool ExportDataAsCode(const unsigned char *data, int dataSize, const char *fileName);
functions.description: Export a data buffer to a C code (.h) file; returns true on success.
requirements: data must point to at least dataSize bytes.
fileName should have a .h (or header) extension and be writable.

functions.name: LoadFileText
functions.description: Load a text file into a newly allocated, null-terminated string buffer.
requirements: fileName must be readable.
On success, returned string must be freed with UnloadFileText().

functions.name: UnloadFileText
functions.description: Free text string previously allocated by LoadFileText().
requirements: text must be a pointer returned by LoadFileText() or NULL.

functions.name: SaveFileText
functions.description: Save a null-terminated string to a file; returns true on success.
requirements: fileName must be a writable path.
text must be a null-terminated string.

functions.name: SetLoadFileDataCallback
functions.description: Set a custom callback for loading binary file data.
requirements: callback must match signature unsigned char *(*)(const char*, int*).
Advanced usage; ensure returned memory contract matches UnloadFileData() or your own convention if overriding both.

functions.name: SetSaveFileDataCallback
functions.description: Set a custom callback for saving binary file data.
requirements: callback must match signature bool (*)(const char*, void*, int).

functions.name: SetLoadFileTextCallback
functions.description: Set a custom callback for loading text file data.
requirements: callback must match signature char *(*)(const char*).

functions.name: SetSaveFileTextCallback
functions.description: Set a custom callback for saving text file data.
requirements: callback must match signature bool (*)(const char*, const char*).

functions.name: FileRename
functions.description: Rename a file if it exists. Returns implementation-defined status (0 commonly success per comment in other file ops; not explicitly stated here).
requirements: fileName must exist and be accessible.
Destination directory must be writable.

functions.name: FileRemove
functions.description: Remove a file if it exists. Returns implementation-defined status.
requirements: fileName should reference an existing file and be removable by the process.

functions.name: FileCopy
functions.description: Copy a file to another path. Creates dstPath if it doesn't exist. Returns implementation-defined status.
requirements: srcPath must exist and be readable.
Parent directory of dstPath must be writable.

functions.name: FileMove
functions.description: Move a file from one directory to another. Creates dstPath if it doesn't exist. Returns implementation-defined status.
requirements: srcPath must exist and be readable.
Destination's parent directory must be writable.

functions.name: FileTextReplace
functions.signature: int FileTextReplace(const char *fileName, const char *search, const char *replacement);
functions.description: Replace occurrences of a string in an existing text file. Returns implementation-defined status.
requirements: fileName must be readable and writable.
search and replacement are null-terminated strings.

functions.name: FileTextFindIndex
functions.description: Find text in an existing file and return an index (per comment).
requirements: fileName must be readable.
search must be a null-terminated string.

functions.name: FileExists
functions.description: Check whether the given file path exists.

functions.name: DirectoryExists
functions.description: Check whether the given directory path exists.

functions.name: IsFileExtension

functions.name: GetDirectoryPath

functions.name: GetPrevDirectoryPath

functions.name: GetWorkingDirectory

functions.name: GetApplicationDirectory

functions.name: MakeDirectory

functions.name: ComputeSHA256
